model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC percentage for six different methods. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number," has a logarithmic scale and ranges from 1 to 10^3, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis, labeled "ACC (%)", has a linear scale and ranges from 40 to 65, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot features six lines, each representing a method: Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME, with distinct colors and marker shapes. The lines are as follows: Base is black with circular markers and a solid line style, starting at around 39 and ending at around 44; FT is blue with triangular markers and a solid line style, starting at around 40 and ending at around 48; IKE is red with triangular markers and a solid line style, starting at around 42 and ending at around 50; MEND is brown with circular markers and a dashed line style, starting at around 43 and ending at around 56; MEMIT is purple with circular markers and a solid line style, starting at around 45 and ending at around 54; ROME is green with square markers and a solid line style, starting at around 52 and ending at around 65.
